request.prompt: Big, brassy jazz-funk chase music for a bank robbery where the alarm just went off. 90 BPM with a hard double-time breakbeat feel, G minor, 4/4, steady tempo throughout. Opens with one massive full-band brass and timpani hit on beat 1, then: heavy funky breakbeat drums, a fat electric bass line, a full brass section (trumpets, trombones, baritone sax) firing stabs and blasting a five-note minor blues motif, a screaming Hammond organ, and a choppy wah guitar. Swaggering, loud and urgent, like a heist crew fighting its way to the getaway van in a 1970s crime film. Structure: 1-bar hit, then 8-bar A, 8-bar variation of A, 8-bar B, a 4-bar drum break with horn stabs, then 8 bars of A again. No ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No EDM, no synth bass, no four-on-the-floor kick, no risers.
